Treatment summary
The patient was seen after a sideswipe collision during a lane change and reports neck
and back strain. The force and mechanism of the impact are consistent with the injuries
described. Care has included 44 visits, with sessions occurring nearly every day, and
new body areas were added several weeks after the collision. Most clinical findings
rest on the patient's own description of pain. Imaging and physical examination tests
have all been within normal limits. The history contains no known prior injury to the
same areas. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same services. Future
management will focus on symptom control, a gradual return to normal activity, and a
review of the treatment plan given the frequency of visits and the spread of
complaints.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
